AI product photos and cards for marketplaces

One phone photo becomes a studio shot, a lifestyle scene and a card text for Uzum Market in minutes, so hundreds of items go on sale without a shoot. Qilich builds the MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 30 mln; the full version in 6–10 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Pipeline for one product category: background removal and studio backgrounds, lifestyle scenes, image sizes for each marketplace, card titles and descriptions in Uzbek and Russian
  • Approval screen
  • Bulk export
What the full version adds
  • Clothing on synthetic models with consistent looks
  • Short video clips
  • Tests of main photos
  • Link to biz-marketplace-sync
  • Brand style rules
Please note

Images show the real product: no changes to colour, shape or details that would mislead buyers. Models are synthetic; no real person's face without written consent.

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
